scripts.events:emulators: pnpm --filter @pprc/functions build && node scripts/events/firebase.mjs emulators:start --project demo-pprc-events
scripts.events:integration: pnpm --filter @pprc/functions build && node scripts/events/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-pprc-events --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "pnpm --filter @pprc/functions test"
scripts.events:e2e: pnpm --filter @pprc/functions build && node scripts/events/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --project demo-pprc-events --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "pnpm events:seed && pnpm exec playwright test tests/core.spec.ts tests/triace.spec.ts tests/club.spec.ts tests/players.spec.ts tests/competitions.spec.ts tests/ladder.spec.ts tests/courts.spec.ts tests/mobile-nav.spec.ts tests/home.spec.ts tests/discovery.spec.ts tests/profile.spec.ts"
